CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE openivm_affected___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f7031_ AS
SELECT DISTINCT island FROM ((SELECT DISTINCT island AS island FROM memory.main.openivm_delta_obs WHERE openivm_timestamp > CAST('2026-11-20 06:28:33.137987' AS TIMESTAMP)) UNION ALL (SELECT DISTINCT island AS island FROM memory.main.obs WHERE code IN (SELECT DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(raw), '') FROM memory.main.openivm_delta_tags WHERE openivm_timestamp > CAST('2026-11-20 06:28:33.137987' AS TIMESTAMP)))) openivm_changed_partitions;

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE openivm_new___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f7031_ AS
SELECT * FROM (WITH
t0_scan (island, moment, seq, token, t2_code, payload, x0, x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9) AS (
    SELECT  island, moment, seq, token, code, payload, x0, x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9
    FROM    memory.main.obs
),
t1_projection (island, moment, seq, token, t2_code, payload, x0, x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9,
               window_0) AS (
    SELECT  island, moment, seq, token, t2_code, payload, x0, x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY island ORDER BY moment DESC NULLS LAST, seq ASC NULLS LAST, token ASC NULLS LAST)
    FROM    t0_scan
),
t2_block_materialized_for_join (t24_code) AS (
    SELECT    CASE WHEN ("trim"(raw)) = (CAST('' AS VARCHAR)) THEN CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) ELSE "trim"(raw) END
    FROM      memory.main.tags
    WHERE     ((upper("trim"(kind))) = (CAST('ACTIVE' AS VARCHAR)))
    GROUP BY  CASE WHEN ("trim"(raw)) = (CAST('' AS VARCHAR)) THEN CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) ELSE "trim"(raw) END
),
t3_join (island, moment, seq, token, t2_code, payload, x0, x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9,
         window_0, t24_code) AS (
    SELECT  t1_projection.island, t1_projection.moment, t1_projection.seq, t1_projection.token,
            t1_projection.t2_code, t1_projection.payload, t1_projection.x0, t1_projection.x1,
            t1_projection.x2, t1_projection.x3, t1_projection.x4, t1_projection.x5,
            t1_projection.x6, t1_projection.x7, t1_projection.x8, t1_projection.x9,
            t1_projection.window_0, t2_block_materialized_for_join.t24_code
    FROM    t1_projection LEFT JOIN t2_block_materialized_for_join ON (t2_code = t24_code)
)
SELECT  token, island, moment AS last_seen, CAST('t' AS BOOLEAN) AS present, t2_code AS code,
        payload, (t24_code) IS NOT NULL AS flagged, x0, x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9,
        t2_code AS openivm_left_key
FROM    t3_join
WHERE   ((window_0) = (CAST(1 AS BIGINT)))) openivm_target
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM openivm_affected___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f7031_ openivm_aff WHERE openivm_aff.island <=> openivm_target.island);

DELETE FROM memory.main.openivm_data___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f7031_ AS openivm_target
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM openivm_affected___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f7031_ openivm_aff WHERE openivm_aff.island <=> openivm_target.island);
